Add or Drop Course Application Form (Special cases only/by manual)
※注意事項Remarks：
․ 表單使用對象－不可抗力之因素導致無法自行上網選課者。 Available only for students who are unable to select courses online due to irresistible reasons.
․ 請留意加選課程是否得列入畢業學分。(例如：重複修習不計入畢業學分) Please note whether the credits hours of taken courses are counted as graduation
requirements or not. The retaken courses will be not counted as graduation credits.
․ 跨選不同學制課程，須依規定補繳學雜(分)費差額。 To take cross-Dept. or cross-college courses, the difference of credits fee must be paid.
․ 以下資料務必完整填寫，加選或退選請於當學期加退選結束前辦理完成，若因資料缺漏或錯誤而致權益受損，敬請自行負責。 Below listed information
must be completely filled out, and apply it before the Add-or-Drop Selection Period deadline. In case of insufficient data or any mistake to cause any rights damage,
students must assume the responsibility by themselves.

□ 延修生或應屆畢業生因個人疏失，若不加選該科目，將影響本學期畢業資格。For repeating students

※以上所填課程須經下列單位同意或審核通過後始得異動選課紀錄；請同學親至教務處辦理並自行上網確認選課紀錄，未確認者一律以電腦紀錄為準。The
above listed add-or-drop courses must be approved and start to make the changes valid online. Students need to hand over the application in person, and must confirm
the final correct courses status in assigned time. If unconfirmed, the final course selection results will be subject to record of the computer database.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
※審核原則：各階段選課依行事曆及公告為準，選課時間已截止，無特殊原因不予異動選課紀錄，以維護學生間的選課公平性。教師、單位主管及教務處應
斟酌學生之理由與修課人數，再決定是否同意特准加/退/棄選。The several periods of course selection refer to Academic Calendar or announcements. In order
to maintenance all students’ course selection rights, if there is no special reason, the selected courses online will be not changed after the course registration deadline.
Teachers, departments and Academic Affairs Office all must assess students’ add-or-drop courses reasons and course enrollments carefully before permission.
